Palo Alto Networks is a global leader in cybersecurity. Its solutions help organizations secure their entire environment from network to cloud, including access and security operations.
The platform is built on a consolidated approach, supported by automation and artificial intelligence. It delivers consistent visibility, advanced protection, and faster incident response.

sections.sectionTitle: A Comprehensive Platform to Secure Your Entire Organization
sections.intro: Palo Alto Networks solutions cover the network, access, cloud environments, and security operations (SecOps). Each product family integrates into a coherent architecture designed to evolve with your needs.

items.title: Cloud and Secure Access
items.text:
Secure your access and cloud environments without compromising performance.

Prisma protects cloud environments and user access wherever they are located. The solution centralizes security, compliance and connectivity policies.

Result: centralized visibility and consistent security, without adding management complexity.

items.title: Network Security
items.text:
Protect your network with next-generation zero trust security.

Strata secures network traffic through in-depth analysis of applicaitons, users, and content. The solution enables precise control of traffic flows and security policies.

Result: granular network control and a significant reduction in your organization's attack surface.

items.title: Security Operations, Detection and Response
items.text:
Detect, analyze, and respond to incidents faster.

Cortex centralizes threat detection, analysis, and response. Automation improves event correlation, accelerates security operations, and supports faster decision-making.

Result: reduced response times and more efficient security operations.

items.title: Threat Intelligence and Services
items.text:
Access advanced cybersecurity expertise.

Unit 42 brings together Palo Alto Networks experts dedicated to threat analysis and major incident response.

Result: better risk understanding and a stronger security posture.

items.title: PA-Series: Next-Gen Firewalls and Specialized Network Hardware
items.text:
Ensure high-performance, resilient network protection in the most demanding environments.

PA-Series firewalls and specialized network hardware protect networks operating at high throughput and in complex data center environments.

Result: high performance and advanced security, without compromise.
